description: This Java source file defines an exception mapper for handling idempotent command exceptions within the Apache Fineract project. It translates specific exceptions into HTTP responses, primarily for REST API interactions, and uses annotations for dependency injection and component scope.

classes.name: IdempotentCommandExceptionMapper
classes.description: This class implements JAX-RS exception mapper to handle specific idempotent command exceptions and convert them into appropriate HTTP responses. It also implements additional interfaces for custom exception handling within the Fineract framework.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an AbstractIdempotentCommandException into an HTTP Response, setting status code and headers based on the exception type.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns a custom error code (4209) for this exception mapper.
